name: ShoreSMP TierTagger
description: This is the ShoreSMP TierList Tier Tagger, a client-side mod for Fabric Minecraft clients. It shows ShoreSMP TierList tiers from LT5 to HT1 in-game across 5 PvP modes: Crystal, Sword, SMP, Mace, and NethOP. Players who have been tested on the ShoreSMP TierList can showcase their earned tier in-game, and other players with the mod can see those public tiers directly. Use /tiertagger (player) to show a player's ShoreSMP tiers in chat. Join the Discord: https://discord.gg/shoretiers
